resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source DFT code)

access.notes: Use any recent stable version. VASP was used in the original work; an open-source equivalent is fully acceptable.
PAW pseudopotentials for Bi, Cu, Se, O. Any standard, well-converged set is acceptable.

Tetragonal P4/nmm (No. 129), lattice parameters a≈3.9337 Å, c≈8.9393 Å, atomic positions as in public literature/ICSD. The exact coordinates can be obtained from a public crystallographic database or reconstructed from the published table.
